original_test_intent: Cause the PMIC to switch from VIN_Mgmt to VIN_Bulk on every required target/comparator, verify the direction and bounded transition without unintended reset or memory corruption unless explicitly specified, and restore the intended input state.
original_method: Map both physical inputs and PMIC addresses; prove railtype6/voltagetype semantics; establish VIN_Mgmt active pre-state; capture synchronized input-select, both input rails and downstream outputs; inject one tuple; measure transfer time, droop and service/memory continuity; record fresh PMIC/RAS evidence; define latch/failback; restore preferred input and platform settings before another target.
manual_activity: The power/PMIC owner maps both inputs and target PMICs, approves the transition and limits, runs one switchover with instrumentation, performs approved failback and restores bus/memory state.
required_inputs: PMIC proof railtype6 means VIN_Mgmt-to-VIN_Bulk and voltagetype0/1 trigger/comparator definitions
Decision on Fatal procedure wording versus correctable Criteria and expected reset/no-reset behavior
Per-DIMM/PMIC physical VIN_Mgmt/VIN_Bulk source and socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm mapping
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path and input-select/status registers
Command continuation plus complete target matrix
Transfer time, voltage-droop/interruption, downstream rail, memory-error and service-continuity limits; latch/failback and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated instrumented SUT with independent OOB path and synchronized dual-input/output telemetry
Confirm VIN_Mgmt is active and VIN_Bulk is healthy before each injection
One target/comparator once; abort on transfer in wrong direction, excess droop/interruption, reset contrary to policy, DIMM/MCA error or unstable bulk input
Do not trigger failback automatically; preserve event/state evidence and use approved return procedure
Restore preferred input, PMIC mode/recovery, SPD ownership, telemetry, I2C and HDT, then validate memory
agent_execution_scope: Validate transition semantics, target/I2C map, synchronized measurement, continuity and failback plan
Collect read-only input-select, dual-input/downstream telemetry, precise timeline, PMIC/CPER/SEL and memory/service health
Do not infer direction/trigger, modify PMIC/I2C/BIOS/HDT, inject, switch/failback, reset, repeat, recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve severity and approve transition matrix
Supervise injection and return to preferred input
Restore state and issue per-target verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic switchover logs cannot establish initial input, actual transition direction, droop duration, continuity or successful failback.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With synchronized telemetry and VIN_Mgmt preselected, run one railtype6 trigger, measure input-select and downstream continuity, correlate fresh evidence, then perform the separately approved failback and memory validation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: listvalidumc, 0:0:3, railtype6, voltagetype0/1, dimm0, Fatal label, correctable Criteria, all-DIMM scope, PMIC/I2C settings and 360/120-minute values remain preserved as disputed inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a serialized, instrumented management-to-bulk transition matrix with measured continuity and controlled failback per PMIC.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds pre-state, transition direction, synchronized rail timing, droop/interruption budget, no-reset/memory-integrity checks and failback proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS cannot prove an actual management-to-bulk transfer or uninterrupted DDR5 power.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong source, unhealthy bulk input or latched transfer can reset the host or corrupt memory state.

project_override_considerations: Read input-selection state through the approved BMC/platform I2C controller. If the platform has no dual-input PMIC or no supported failback, record applicability explicitly rather than repurposing this as an input-only case.
expected_evidence: Railtype6/trigger specification and physical dual-input PMIC/DIMM/I2C topology
Pinned tool/spec and synchronized pre-state showing VIN_Mgmt active and VIN_Bulk valid
Exact injection with input-select, both inputs and downstream rail timeline
Fresh switchover-specific PMIC/CPER/SEL event, measured transfer/droop and approved reset/no-reset outcome
Stable DIMM/MCA/workload/service health, documented latch and approved failback to preferred input

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure labels the operation Fatal while Criteria calls it correctable, with no reset rule. It requests all DIMMs and voltage types0/1 from one fixed tuple, the split command is ambiguous, and transition direction/timing, continuity, latch and failback criteria are missing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The management-to-bulk switchover purpose is explicit. Engineering can define the transition contract and topology, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 95 Wistron-System RAS-00815-V002: prove railtype6 implements VIN_Mgmt-to-VIN_Bulk and define voltagetype0/1 triggers; reconcile Fatal label with correctable Criteria and reset/no-reset policy; map every DIMM/PMIC and both physical inputs plus Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path; approve command/tuple matrix, initial input, transfer/droop/interruption limits, PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, latch/failback, memory/service recovery, aborts and restoration.

review_improvement: Turns a generic PMIC event into a measured directional power-path transfer with continuity, memory integrity and failback evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Switchover success requires observing both the selected-input bit and electrical continuity; neither a tool PASS nor the word switchover proves that VIN_Mgmt released and VIN_Bulk assumed load. The source gives no pre-state or timing and contradicts itself on severity. Each PMIC/comparator must be measured independently, and failback is a separate controlled action because a latched bulk state can affect following tests.
